decks.name: Odds and Ends - Secret Lair Commander
decks.description:
Meet [[Yennett, Cryptic Sovereign]]. When she's not busy testing people with various esoteric riddles, she's letting you cast spells with odd mana values for free off the top of your library. This deck is packed with splashy spells you'll want to cheat out with Yennett, like [[Profane Transfusion]], [[Ethersworn Sphinx]], and [[Master of Predicaments]]. But like any good riddle, this one has a trick. Stack the odds in your favor with [[Sensei's Divining Top]], [[Brainstorm]], and other library-manipulating abilities to ensure Yennett's ability always gives you something powerful.

Beyond her quandaries, queries, and questions, Yennett is prepared to puzzle players with a profusion of perplexing spells. Take control of the board with [[Space Beleren]]; scramble the battlefield with [[Inniaz, the Gale Force]]; and build up card advantage with [[Thief of Sanity]]. Then, answer the ultimate riddle of "Who is going to win this game?" The answer? You.

Released via Secret Lair on 9/28/2026, the deck contained: 

1x Ready-to-play 100-card Commander deck
	12x Foil cards featuring new artwork from Ricardo Cavolo
	4x Foil borderless basic Plains from The Oddlands: Plains
	4x Foil borderless basic Islands from The Oddlands: Islands
	4x Foil borderless basic Swamps from The Oddlands: Swamps
	76x Non-foil reprints
10x Non-foil double-sided tokens
1x Yennett, Cryptic Sovereign display commander (not legal in sanctioned play)
1x Deck box

decks.name: Keen Engineering - Foundations Commander
decks.description: Work with Sai to engineer useful artifacts and generate flying Thopters as a bonus. Make unexpected plays and draw additional cards to let the cogs of your strategy click into place!

decks.name: Reign of Dragons - Foundations Commander
decks.description: Your reign over the table begins with Lathliss, who creates a Dragon when a non-token Dragon enters. Use Treasure tokens and cost-reduction effects to send out your fiercest Dragons early and drown the world in fire!

decks.name: Calling All Angels - Foundations Commander
decks.description: Hope arrives in full force with Giada and her ability to strengthen any Angels you cast. Play a whole host of Angels, reap the divine benefits, and ascend to victory!

decks.name: Wretched Ranks - Foundations Commander
decks.description: Overrun the table's defenses with [[Ghoulcaller Gisa]], who can rapidly build a Zombie army. Once your shambling horde reaches critical mass, boost their attack and send everyone else to the graveyard!

decks.name: Tramplesaurus Rex - Foundations Commander
decks.description: Tower over the rest of the food chain with Ghalta and let high-power creatures run wild on the battlefield. Higher attack power reduces Ghalta's casting cost, so unleash her as soon as possible and trample the competition!

decks.name: Multiverse Reforged - Reality Fracture
decks.description: Helmed by the four-color planeswalker [[Jace, Multiverse Architect]], this deck is packed with new-to-Magic cards that depict Echoverse versions of some of your favorite Magic legends. There's a mono-white Ob Nixilis, a mono-black Avacyn, even a colorless Omnath - you've seen these characters before, but you've never seen them quite like this.

decks.name: Scions & Spellcraft - Final Fantasy Commander
decks.description: Scions & Spellcraft is based around Final Fantasy XIV and features little-known, under-the-radar commander [[Y'shtola, Night's Blessed]] at the helm of a deck designed to gain control and card advantage by slinging spells.

decks.name: Limit Break - Final Fantasy Commander
decks.description: Focused around Final Fantasy VII, the Limit Break preconstructed deck is themed around all things 7 power, as [[Cloud, Ex-SOLDIER]] fights for the planet's future alongside powerful allies and equipment.

decks.name: Revival Trance - Final Fantasy Commander
decks.description: Revival Trance is a Final Fantasy VI-themed deck built around graveyard reanimation. The Mardu-colored deck is centered around [[Terra, Herald of Hope]] resurrecting small creatures from the graveyard.

decks.name: Everyone's Invited - Secret Lair Drop - WUBRG EDH Precon Decklist
decks.description: Built around a core crew of powerful Shapeshifters and featuring a guestlist of Dryads, Elementals, Faeries, Slivers, Cats and more, this 100% reprint deck is a celebration for every creature type (as long as they love to party). Overwhelm your opponents with a swarm of Shapeshifters, or just invite them in to enjoy the good times—it’s your party.

decks.name: Blight Curse - Lorwyn Eclipsed Commander Deck
decks.description:
Blight your enemies with the power of -1/-1 counters with Blight Curse, the Jund-colored preconstructed Commander deck from Lorwyn Eclipsed. 

Three new legendary creatures - [[Auntie Ool, Cursewretch]], [[The Reaper, King No More]], and [[Ferrafor, Young Yew]] - join the fray, alongside new cards [[Dread Tiller]], [[Oft-Nabbed Goat]], [[Village Pillagers]], [[Grave Venerations]], [[Puca's Covenant]], [[Wickersmith's Tools]], [[Eventide's Shadow]], and [[Aberrant Return]].

decks.name: Dance of the Elements - Lorwyn Eclipsed Commander Deck
decks.description:
Rally your elemental army and bring some primordial punishment to your opponents with this five-color Commander deck from Lorwyn Eclipsed.

This list features two new Commanders: [[Ashling, the Limitless]] and [[Mass of Mysteries]]. Alongside those two, new cards include [[Jubiliation]], [[Impulsivity]], [[Lamentation]], [[Belonging]], [[Subterfuge]], [[Elemental Spectacle]], [[Springleaf Parade]], [[Rain-Slicked Copse]], [[Sodden Verdure]] and [[Abundant Countryside]]. 

The deck also includes first-ever reprints of two Shadowmoor rares: [[Slithermuse]] and [[Cream of the Crop]].

decks.name: Turtle Power! - Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Commander Deck
decks.description:
Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles brings along just one Commander deck, dubbed Turtle Power! This five-color deck allows for any combination of Leonardo, the Balance paired up with the titular turtles (and Splinter or April, of course). Alternately, you can select Heroes in a Half Shell as the deck's Commander. 

The deck is themed around a number of strategies: Mutant, Ninja, and Turtle Typal, Artifacts matter, Sneak (ninjutsu) and disappear, and Mutagen tokens/+1/+1 counters. Will all these strategies cohere into a functional deck? Experiment in the Playtester to find out!

decks.name: Goblin Storm - Secret Lair Commander
decks.description:
This deck's strategy is right in its name: play Goblins and wield a storm of spells to devastate your opponents.

Headlined by reprints of [[Goblin Lackey]], [[Brightstone Ritual]] and [[Roaming Throne]], Goblin Storm released via Secret Lair on May 18, 2025.

decks.name: Silverquill Influence - Secrets of Strixhaven
decks.description: It's all about Auras with Silverquill Influence, the black/white Secrets of Strixhaven preconstructed deck. Whether you're going with Killian, Decisive Mentor in the lead, or fellow newcomer Scriv, the Obligator, you're looking to maximize your Auras' value coming and going to grind out a victory.

decks.name: Avengers Assemble - Marvel Super Heroes
decks.description: Assemble your own team of Heroes with Captain America, Team Leader, and throw your mighty shield into battle! Director Nick Fury will keep your hand stocked with Heroes that are ready to take on whatever threats come your way.

decks.name: Hatsune Miku - Secret Lair Commander
decks.description:
Hatsune Miku is taking the stage. The Commander stage, specifically.

Known around the world as a virtual singer, creative icon, and very serious collector of excellent outfits, Hatsune Miku arrives with Secret Lair Commander Deck: Hatsune Miku. This ready-to-play Commander deck brings together music, community, bright new artwork, and a green-white strategy that knows exactly what it wants to do: play creatures, gain life, and keep building until the table has no choice but to deal with it—and it all comes to Secret Lair on August 10.

decks.name: Wakanda Forever - Marvel Super Heroes
decks.description: T'Challa, the Black Panther and his royal allies have arrived to pave a path to victory. For a more aggressive approach to diplomacy, try having Shuri, the Black Panther helm the deck.

decks.name: Doom Prevails - Marvel Super Heroes
decks.description: A master of science, sorcery, and schemes, Doctor Doom, King of Latveria has arrived in Magic: The Gathering. If you're feeling tricksy, Loki, the Deceiver is here to fool your foes and copy your most powerful Villains.

decks.name: The Fantastic Four - Marvel Super Heroes
decks.description: Pick your favorite member of Marvel's First Family and push science to its limits!

decks.name: Quandrix Unlimited - Secrets of Strixhaven
decks.description: Master magic and mathematics with Quandrix Unlimited, Secrets of Strixhaven's green/blue preconstructed deck. Exponentially excoriating opponents is the aim, with Zimone, Infinite Analyst and Primo, the Unbounded leading you toward massive X-spells and huge numbers.

decks.name: Witherbloom Pestilence - Secrets of Strixhaven
decks.description: Witherbloom Pestilence, the green/black preconstructed deck from Secrets of Strixhaven, gives you mastery over the cycle of life and death...and pests. Both Dina, Essence Brewer and Gorma, the Gullet want to see creatures die, and luckily, the deck's full of ways to make that happen.

decks.name: Lorehold Spirit - Secrets of Strixhaven
decks.description: Turn dusty old history into a powerful weapon with Lorehold Spirit, the red/white preconstructed deck from Secrets of Strixhaven. Led by the planeswalking Quintorius, History Chaser or Excava, the Risen Past, the strategy is straightforward - dig up ancient history, create Spirits, and dominate past, present and future.

decks.name: Prismari Artistry - Secrets of Strixhaven
decks.description: Overwhelm the battlefield with splashy spells and attention-grabbing abilities with Prismari Artistry, the red/blue preconstructed deck from Secrets of Strixhaven. Led by your choice of Rootha, Mastering the Moment or Muddle, the Ever-Changing, the goal is simple: shock and awe.

decks.name: Counter Intelligence - Edge of Eternities Commander Deck
decks.description:
Whether it's charge counters, +1/+1 counters or even indestructible counters, we're looking to proliferate until the heat death of the universe with Counter Intelligence, the Jeskai (WUR)-colored preconstructed deck of Edge of Eternities. 

Assemble some of Magic: The Gathering's most notorious synergies behind either Kilo, Apogee Mind or Inspirit, Flagship Vessel  - two commanders both suited for the helm of an artifact-heavy, counter-rich 99. And when all else fails, just start charging up the Darksteel Reactor, which is seeing its first-ever reprint after appearing in Darksteel more than 21 years ago.

Joining our two eligible commanders are ten other new cards: Insight Engine,Uthros Research Craft, Long-Range Sensor, Moxite Refinery, Solar Array, Patrolling Peacemaker, Depthshaker Titan, Surge Conductor, Glittering Massif and Radiant Summit.

decks.name: World Shaper - Edge of Eternities Commander Deck
decks.description:
Bending the world (or worlds) of Magic: The Gathering to our will is the name of the game with World Shaper, the Jund-colored (BRG) preconstructed deck featured with Edge of Eternities.

Guided by Szarel, Genesis Shepherd as our insectoid Crucible of Worlds-inspired commander, we're looking to take advantage of lands coming and going onto the battlefield, graveyard and beyond to build an insurmountable advantage. Our alternate commander is Hearthhull, the Worldseed, a Spacecraft that gains land-sacrificing momentum as we work to power up its stations with charge counters.

In addition to reprints, we've got 10 new cards with which to wreak havoc: Exploration Broodship, Eumidian Wastewaker, Evendo Brushrazer, Baloth Prime, Horizon Explorer, Scouring Swarm, Planetary Annihilation, Eumidian Hatchery, Festering Thicket and Vernal Fen.

World Shaper was originally revealed via the Command Zone YouTube Channel.
